notes: Alacritty is a real emulator; input is synthetic XTest in an isolated display.
Every source pixel is compared at full size; allow at most 1/255 per RGB channel for X11 rounding.
Only a generated fixture library/window is used; publisher text and the private note are independently checked.
Xvfb tools, ueberzugpp and their official Debian libraries were extracted under /tmp; no system packages were installed.
The temporary helper dependency prefix uses LD_LIBRARY_PATH only for display qualification; Rust toolchain and published crate sources are unchanged.
No helper executable or GPL implementation is linked, copied into sources or redistributed.
XTest release may emit a second detent; observe one press without modifier cleanup releasing the button.
Earlier attempts exposed modifier-cleanup and queued-write observation bugs in the test driver, now fixed.
An initial whole-bitmap exact-equality check rejected 1/255 X11 rounding; full geometry and all-channel bounds are now explicit.
One display startup attempt timed out during concurrent compilation; the isolated final run passed after compilation finished.
Actual Wayland compositors, physical mouse hardware and display latency are not qualified by this test.
